name: She Whispers
source:
A Calamity has come to plague the world once more, and so the Hero returns to defeat it once more. After waking up once more and needing to build back her strength, she's taken in by the quiet writer Shin. And as they spend the days together, the Hero begins to remember what it is to be human.

[From [url=https://n3ur0515-vt.itch.io/she-whispers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场灾难再次降临到世界上，因此英雄回来再次击败它。再次醒来并需要恢复体力后，她被安静的作家申收留。当他们一起度过的日子里，英雄开始记起人类是什么。

[来自[url=https://n3ur0515-vt.itch.io/she-whispers]itch.io[/url]]
